note: Scale for a bone part mesh and its part-level coordinate systems, applied about the part origin. The hand-drawn humerus and ulna put their part origin at the proximal joint centre (GH_J and ELBOW_J), so scaling about the origin keeps the joint centre fixed and lengthens the bone distally. Both bones are now scaled inside SolidWorks itself (length x1.2, confirmed by the 2026-10-12 export: GH_J->ELBOW_J went 220 mm -> 264 mm, cross sections unchanged), so the factors here are back to 1.0. Do not turn them on again while the SolidWorks parts already carry the scale.
